en_title: With The Division 3 Still in Active Development, Ubisoft Announces The Division Franchise Has Hit More Than 50 Million Players
subtitle: 十周年，特工仍在集结
opus_summary: Massive宣布，《全境封锁》系列十周年之际，玩家数突破5,000万。《全境封锁3》仍在开发，尚无发售日期；二代新DLC将于11月3日推出。

paragraphs.en: Massive Entertainment has announced that The Division series has recorded over 50 million players across its games, just as the series hits its 10th anniversary. That’s a lot of +1 defense beanies!
paragraphs.cn: Massive Entertainment宣布，正值《全境封锁》系列迎来十周年，旗下各款游戏的玩家总数已突破5,000万。那得有多少顶防御力＋1的毛线帽啊！

paragraphs.en: The long-running looter shooter began life in 2016 with the launch of The Division. It came out three years after its flashy reveal at Ubisoft's E3 2013 conference which, at the time, exceeded expectation for next-gen gaming (remember when the guy closed the car door while in cover?). The Division 2 followed in 2019, but sales failed to meet Ubisoft's expectations. A number of spinoffs have come and gone since.
paragraphs.cn: 这个长寿的刷宝射击系列始于2016年发售的《全境封锁》。在此三年前，游戏曾在育碧2013年E3发布会上惊艳亮相，当时展示的效果超出了人们对次世代游戏的期待（还记得那个角色躲在掩体后顺手关上车门的画面吗？）。《全境封锁2》随后于2019年推出，但销量未能达到育碧的预期。此后，多部衍生作品也先后登场又退场。

paragraphs.en: Massive Entertainment announced a new DLC for The Division 2 at a community panel at Gamescom earlier this year. The Echoes of Central Park DLC releases on November 3. It seems likely the new expansion — which adds a horror-themed flashback campaign, a stash space increase, a level boost, and more — will see even more players shoot numbers out of some guys across the U.S., both returning and new.
paragraphs.cn: 在今年早些时候科隆游戏展的社区座谈会上，Massive Entertainment公布了《全境封锁2》的新DLC。《Echoes of Central Park》将于11月3日推出。这部新扩展将加入恐怖主题的回溯战役、增加储物箱空间、提供等级提升等内容，看来很可能会吸引更多新老玩家，在美国各地朝敌人开枪，打出一串串伤害数字。

paragraphs.en: With those kinds of numbers, it’s no surprise Ubisoft and Massive aren’t done with the series. Tom Clancy's The Division 3 is also officially in production at Massive Entertainment. Originally headed up by executive producer Julian Gerighty (who also led Star Wars Outlaws and The Division 2), The Division 3 is now in the hands of creative director Mathias Karlson, game director on The Division 2. Gerighty recently left Ubisoft to work at Battlefield developer DICE .
paragraphs.cn: 有这样的玩家规模，育碧和Massive继续投入这个系列也就不足为奇了。Massive Entertainment也已正式着手制作《汤姆克兰西：全境封锁3》。该作最初由执行制作人Julian Gerighty领衔，他也曾负责《星球大战：亡命之徒》和《全境封锁2》。如今，《全境封锁3》已交由创意总监Mathias Karlson负责，他此前担任《全境封锁2》的游戏总监。Gerighty最近离开育碧，加入《战地风云》开发商DICE。

paragraphs.en: Gerighty confirmed his departure in a social media post just a week after appearing on a livestream to promote The Division 3 . “So, The Division 3 is in production, right?” he said before his departure. “This is not a secret. It's been announced. It's shaping up to be a monster.
paragraphs.cn: Gerighty在直播中为《全境封锁3》宣传仅一周后，就通过社交媒体发文确认离职。他在离职前表示：「《全境封锁3》正在制作中，对吧？这不是什么秘密，消息已经公布了。它正逐渐成为一部重磅之作。

paragraphs.en: “I can't really say anything more than that. But this is, within these walls in Massive, we are working extremely hard on something that I think will be as big an impact as Division 1 was.”
paragraphs.cn: 「除此之外，我实在不能透露更多。但在Massive工作室里，我们正全力以赴打造一款作品，我认为它将带来与初代《全境封锁》同样巨大的影响。」

paragraphs.en: Following his departure, Massive reassured fans that The Division 3 was in safe hands. “For our players, don’t worry, Agents,” the studio said in a social media post. “Our teams who built this world with Julian are still here, carrying it forward with an ambitious, unchanged commitment to the future.”
paragraphs.cn: Gerighty离职后，Massive向粉丝保证，《全境封锁3》仍由可靠的团队负责。工作室在社交媒体发文表示：「各位玩家、各位特工，请不要担心。与Julian共同打造这个世界的团队仍在这里，大家对未来的雄心与承诺丝毫未变，会继续推动这个世界向前发展。」

paragraphs.en: There’s no word on when The Division 3 will launch, but Ubisoft is making it a priority. Late last year, Massive Entertainment introduced what it called a "voluntary career transition program," as part of a move to focus on The Division franchise and its Snowdrop game engine.
paragraphs.cn: 《全境封锁3》何时发售尚无消息，但育碧正将其列为优先项目。去年年底，Massive Entertainment推出了所谓的「自愿职业转型计划」，这是其将重心转向《全境封锁》系列和Snowdrop游戏引擎的举措之一。
